verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Elicit's support site serves a valid llms.txt file (HTTP 200) listing its help-center content, which an AI agent could be pointed at for agent-oriented docs; this is corroborated by the general docs corpus. Missing for 10: no first-party announcement or documentation explicitly promoting the llms.txt file as an agent-consumption feature, and no independent community report of using it this way.
